svg.aria-label: An isometric pull request machine on a bench. "?" blocks standing for pull requests drop out of a green warp pipe onto a conveyor and pass under a review stamp that turns each one into a coin. 14 merged pull requests are coins in the brick crate and 23 wait under review in the tray. The dial reads 38 % merged. By project: Symfony 14 merged, 2 under review; API Platform 0 merged, 8 under review; API Platform installer 0 merged, 2 under review; Caddy 0 merged, 8 under review; Ting 0 merged, 3 under review.
svg.title: 14 merged and 23 under review open source pull requests
